title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Metric, business outcome, definition, unit, cohort, baseline/period, target, source system, data owner, collection date/cadence, quality guardrail, attribution, status

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Mean handle time for selected case class; baseline not measured; operations owner to sample before rollout; resolution quality guardrail.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: No target-as-baseline substitution; comparable cohorts and definitions.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Assumption ID, parameter, value/unit, customer/benchmark/fictional, source/date, confidence caveat, sensitivity, validation owner/date, approved for use

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: AS-01: 8 minutes/event is fictional avoidable burden for training, not actual time saved or customer evidence.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Every material claim traceable; evidence labels and publication clearance explicit.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Scenario, population, adoption, frequency, time basis, annualization, efficiency/coverage, recapture, rate, risk, benefits, costs, ROI, caveat

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Use ROI Lab; capacity benefits shown separately from cash savings, revenue and overlapping workflow benefits.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Units match; conservative/base/upside visible; source-formula discrepancies disclosed.
